name: SYLA Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: SYLA Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, primarily develops, constructs, sells, and manages apartments in Japan. The company engages in the land purchase, design, construction, operation, and maintenance of solar power plants. It also provides real estate leasing, management, and brokerage services, as well as real estate crowdfunding services on the Rimawari-kun platform. In addition, the company offers a system that automatically collects various real estate data online, develops real estate investment, machine learning algorithms, RPA, and business systems using this system. Further, the company provides consulting on business automation and AI system implementation for corporations; real estate investment and asset management; operates and sells renewable energy-related products; and sells and maintains solar and biomass power generation equipment. Additionally, the company engages in electricity brokerage, sale of electricity, renewable energy trading, and trade brokerage activities. SYLA Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
